name: dropzone
summary: Files dropped on a region, or picked, checked against the input's own rules and listed.

accept.doc: What may be chosen or dropped: image/*, .pdf, an exact type.

multiple.doc: Whether more than one file is kept.

data-max-bytes.doc: The largest file accepted, in bytes.

data-limit.doc: How many files are kept at most.

picker.doc: The file input; its rules judge a drop too. Without one, every file is accepted.

files.doc: The files kept; file is the real File.

rejected.doc: The files the last batch refused, and why.

dragging.doc: Whether files are being dragged over the region.

clear.doc: Removes every file and every rejection.
